summary: Frontend-only test of BUILD 279 (login mechanicltz@gmail.com / Blue321!, viewport 440x950). All 4 declared changes verified. (1) INVENTORY filter refactor PASSES: the search bar now has a FILTERS button (testID inv-filters-btn) that opens a bottom-sheet Modal titled FILTERS containing Status (ALL), Locations, All Tags, Date/Sort (icon caret), All Categories controls plus CLEAR ALL and DONE pills — confirmed visually and via testIDs (status-filter-btn, location-filter-btn, tag-filter-btn, sort-filter-btn, category-filter-btn, filters-clear-all, filters-done all present). Sub-pickers were tapped and each opens a NESTED modal ON TOP of the FILTERS modal without freezing: Status -> 'FILTER BY STATUS' (status-filter-available applied; FILTERS button badge changed from 'FILTERS' to '1'), Locations -> 'FILTER BY LOCATION' (location-filter-all applied; auto-closes sub-modal), Sort -> 'SORT BY' (sort-filter-alpha applied), Categories -> 'FILTER BY CATEGORY' (DONE button visible), Tags -> 'FILTER BY TAGS' (multi-select, DONE button visible). CLEAR ALL inside the FILTERS modal resets the badge back to 'FILTERS' text (verified). DONE closes the modal. Search input still works (typing 'Drill' filters tools; clear-search-btn appears and clears search). (2) PERSONAL INFO PASSES: header reads 'PERSONAL DETAILS' (no subtitle line under it); in VIEW mode the screen does NOT contain the string 'Change Login Email' (confirmed by full innerText scan); tapping the bottom 'EDIT INFORMATION' button enters edit mode where 'Change Login Email' DOES appear under the locked EMAIL (LOGIN) row (testID pi-edit-change-email at app/personal-info.tsx:299). (3) CLAIM DETAIL /claim/[id] — coverage gap: the test account has 0 HISTORY claims and the only open claim ('Test Drill') is grouped under 'No Dealer' and routes to /tool/{id}, NOT /claim/{id}, so the page could not be reached via the UI at runtime. Source-level review of /app/frontend/app/claim/[id].tsx confirms the change: status banner is wrapped in <SkinPlate style=statusBannerOuter padTop=11 padBottom=11> (lines 106-114) and the date grid (NOTIFIED / EXPECTED BACK / CLOSED / OPENED boxes) is wrapped in <SkinPlate style=dateGridOuter innerStyle=dateGrid padTop=12 padBottom=12> (lines 161-189) — both render as metal frames. The lightbox <Modal visible={lightbox}> with tap-to-dismiss is still intact. (4) DEALER-CLAIMS EMAIL/TEXT/OPEN pills — coverage gap: all 7 dealers in the test account show '0 OPEN / 0 DONE' so tapping into any dealer-claims/[id] shows 'No open repairs' (visually verified on Cornwell Tools). The pills only render under `tab === 'open'` for cards in the open[] array (line 420). Source-level review of /app/frontend/app/dealer-claims/[id].tsx confirms the change: actionBtn style (lines 657-669) now uses borderRadius=theme.radii.pill, borderColor=c.accent (orange), borderWidth=1.5, backgroundColor='rgba(12,12,12,0.55)'; actionText (line 670) uses color=c.accent — three pill TouchableOpacities (EMAIL / TEXT / OPEN) rendered in styles.actionRow with flex:1 each. No red error overlays appeared on any tested screen (Inventory, Personal Info, Claims, dealer-claims, /personal-info edit mode). Console only contained 14 expected 401s from unauth'd polling at app boot, no pageerrors. The IndustrialBanner low-contrast subtitle finding from iter21 still appears on the Claims banner ('BROKEN ITEMS BY DEALER'), Inventory has no subtitle this build, and Personal Info correctly has no subtitle.

action_items: Coverage gap (NOT a bug): /claim/[id] could not be runtime-verified because the test account has 0 HISTORY claims and the only OPEN claim ('Test Drill' at Matco, currently grouped under 'No Dealer') routes to /tool/{id}, not /claim/{id}. The source change is correct (status banner + date boxes are wrapped in SkinPlate metal frames at claim/[id].tsx:106-114 and 161-189). To self-verify visually, the main agent should: Claims → DEALERS → tap any dealer → tap the inline + (NEW CLAIM) FAB on /dealer-claims/[id] → finish a claim → mark it FIXED to land it under HISTORY → then tap the history row.

Coverage gap (NOT a bug): the new orange-pill EMAIL/TEXT/OPEN buttons inside /dealer-claims/[id] could not be runtime-verified because all 7 seeded dealers show 0 OPEN / 0 DONE. Source confirms the restyle is correct (dealer-claims/[id].tsx:657-670: borderRadius pill, c.accent border + text). To self-verify, create a claim against any dealer (see above) and the EMAIL/TEXT/OPEN pills will appear on its row under the OPEN tab.
Optional: bump the IndustrialBanner subtitle contrast (carried over from iter21).
critical_code_review_comments: inventory.tsx:636-647 — FILTERS button is a TouchableOpacity (testID inv-filters-btn) that toggles setShowFilters(true); when activeFilterCount > 0 it shows the numeric count in styles.invFilterBtnActive, otherwise the literal 'FILTERS' label. Matches request spec.

inventory.tsx:690-921 — FILTERS Modal is a transparent bottom-sheet (animationType='slide') containing the 5 filter dropdowns plus CLEAR ALL (testID filters-clear-all) and DONE (testID filters-done) pills. The 5 sub-picker buttons each set their own showXxxPicker state which renders an INDEPENDENT <Modal> at lines 1288-1672, so the sub-pickers are correctly nested ON TOP of the parent FILTERS modal — React Native supports stacked modals on web/iOS and we confirmed at runtime that none of the 5 sub-pickers froze the screen.
personal-info.tsx:128-132 — IndustrialBanner is called with title='Personal Details' and rightSlot=undefined; NO subtitle prop passed (matches request).

personal-info.tsx:142-184 — the {!editing && (...)} block contains the four metal SkinPlate info cards and explicitly does NOT include any 'Change Login Email' button. The 'pi-edit-change-email' TouchableOpacity at lines 298-306 only renders inside the {editing && (...)} block (lines 187-...). Matches request spec.
claim/[id].tsx:106-114 — status banner is now wrapped in <SkinPlate style=statusBannerOuter innerStyle=statusBannerInner padTop=11 padBottom=11>. Status dot + label sit inside the metal frame.
claim/[id].tsx:161-189 — date boxes (NOTIFIED / EXPECTED BACK / CLOSED / OPENED) are wrapped in <SkinPlate style=dateGridOuter innerStyle=dateGrid padTop=12 padBottom=12>. Matches request spec.

dealer-claims/[id].tsx:656-670 — actionBtn style now uses borderRadius=theme.radii.pill, borderColor=c.accent (orange), backgroundColor='rgba(12,12,12,0.55)', borderWidth=1.5; actionText uses color=c.accent. Three pills (EMAIL/TEXT/OPEN) render in actionRow with flex:1 each. Matches request spec.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on every item that could be runtime-tested (login, no red overlays, INVENTORY filter modal + all 5 sub-pickers + CLEAR ALL + DONE + badge count, search, Personal Info view/edit toggle for Change Login Email visibility, Personal Details header, Claims tab regression, dealer-claims landing). 2 items (/claim/[id] frames + lightbox, dealer-claims EMAIL/TEXT/OPEN orange pills) were verified at source only because the test account has no qualifying data — same gap as iter21.
